title: Pretty Nice...but
text: Pretty Nice...but. This grill is really nice but it is not smokeless. We filled our whole apartment up with smoke. Good thing is we figured out our smoke detectors were not working. Works great outside! Shipping was fast!

product_metadata.title: Kuyal Electric Griddle 2-in-1 Indoor Grill Smokeless Coated Non-Stick Pancake Griddle with Cool-touch Handle, 16.7''x8.9'' Extra Large Surface,5-Level Control, 1600W, Black
features: 🍗2 IN 1 Surface:16*9 inch family-size surface can comfortably serve 3-5 people and there is nothing more versatile than the 2-in-1 cooking area(falt/ textured ) for griddling and grilling. The flat surface is perfect for pancakes, eggs, etc. The textured surface can form beautiful textures on steaks, chicken, bacon and other foods.

🥟Less smoke and healthier: 5-degree inclined drainage function, dual grease channels and removable drip tray help to automatically collect excess fat in food. Compared with traditional grills, electric ovens are more environmentally friendly and will not produce harmful smoke or cause fires.

🥩 5-Level adjustable thermostat: Equipped with a thermostat, just plug it in and set the heat probe to the temperature you want, and it can be used for vegetables, seafood, steak, bacon, pancakes, omelets, grilled cheese, etc.The uniform heating system can avoid scorching.

🍤Premium non-stick cooking surface-Healthy: Eco non-stick surface does not contain PTFE and can provide non-stick cooking. Food can be released immediately without oil. The thickest sauce will not stick or leave a residue.
🍟 Easy to Clean:Nonstick coating and smooth surface, use-food slips off non-stick surfaces, making cleaning easier.
